description: Agent policy configuration defining exactly what each AI trading agent is permitted to do. Enforced in addition to, and never looser than, the global riskPolicy in ai-trading-protocol.json.

approvalWorkflowRules.description: General rules governing who must sign off on which trades, applied on top of per-agent approvalWorkflow blocks.
rules: Trades at or below an agent's maxPerTradeNotionalUSD and within its autonomy level's auto-execute threshold may proceed without human approval.
Trades exceeding maxPerTradeNotionalUSD or maxDailyAggregateNotionalUSD always require approval from at least one listed approver.

Any restrictedAction (options, shorting, margin, leverage, futures, crypto_derivatives) is blocked outright and cannot be approved by agent policy alone; it requires an explicit protocol/policy change.
An agent that is rejected twice consecutively has its approvalWorkflow forced to 'requires-human-approval' for all subsequent trades until manually reset.
